Name: Muscovy Ducks
Author: Tsubanii
Description:
This mod is a tribute for my Duck, [b]DUG[/b].

[b]Dug[/b] was a Muscovy Duck who died may 2019.

You can see him here: [url=https://imgur.com/gallery/DMveE]DUG[/url][url=https://imgur.com/gallery/DMveEhttp://]

[/url]You have two options to use this mod, just replacing the .xnb file on content/animals or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] + [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. It's your choice!

Have fun.

PS: He was using a green tie on the photos but he doesn't have a tie in-game.
